## About me

I’m Brijeshkumar, a full stack engineer based in India. I build products where every detail matters.

I was born in Uttar Pradesh and moved to Gujarat, where I started my schooling.

During the COVID pandemic, schools shut down and I suddenly had a lot of time at home. I didn’t have a clear plan for what to do next, but I wanted to learn something. That’s when I discovered coding through YouTube.

I started learning from home, following tutorials, writing code, and slowly building things on my own. There was no degree, bootcamp, or structured roadmap—just YouTube, curiosity, and a lot of time spent figuring things out.

In 2021, before finishing school, I landed my first job as a Frontend Engineer.

Now, I’m still learning, building, and exploring.
